coverage_note: Independent complete factual review after live primary-source checks, including actual displayed definitions. Separate raw quality and allocated-ID critique remain required. No author judgment is treated as verification.

issues.issue: The public oven definition describes baking food; the crumb definition includes bread and biscuit fragments. The manufacturer cooking tables explicitly include bread and biscuits. Either independent intermediate gives a short everyday bake-to-fragment journey. These are ordinary kitchen objects across generations; no geographical, nutritional or exclusive-recipe claim is needed. Sources: https://media3.bsh-group.com/Documents/9001253126_A.pdf ; https://dexonline.ro/definitie/firimitur%C4%83

Powdered sugar is finely milled sugar used in cream and dusting. Eisler explicitly dusts ladyfingers with powdered sugar and uses whipped cream in his chilled Diplomat cake; his decoration also combines cream and powdered sugar. Minimal independently sells the fruit/cream/ladyfinger dessert. The public target description allows sponge or ladyfingers. Both intermediates support variant-aware, recognizable routes without inventing a universal recipe. Sources: https://www.roberteisler.ro/retete/tort-diplomat ; https://cofetariaminimal.ro/produs/tort-diplomat
